description: A control is fully compliant when all expected outcomes are demonstrated through evidence.
logic: IF evidence exists for all expected outcomes AND evidence is current AND evidence covers scope THEN control_status = 'compliant'

description: A control is non-compliant when critical evidence is missing or controls are not implemented.
logic: IF (mandatory evidence missing OR control not implemented) THEN control_status = 'non_compliant' AND finding_severity = 'high'

description: A control is partially compliant when some evidence exists but gaps remain.
logic: IF (evidence exists for some expected outcomes OR controls partially implemented) AND (gaps in coverage or evidence quality) THEN control_status = 'partially_compliant'

description: Evidence must be current, complete, and cover the full scope of the organization.
logic: IF (evidence_date > 12 months OR evidence scope < organization scope) THEN evidence_quality = 'insufficient' AND finding_priority = 'high'

description: Evidence and control implementation must be consistent across all departments.
logic: IF (control implementation varies by department AND no compensating controls exist) THEN inconsistency_finding = True

description: Policies must be communicated, understood, and enforced, not merely documented.
logic: IF (policy exists AND no evidence of communication OR no evidence of enforcement) THEN policy_effective = False AND finding_type = 'operational_effectiveness'

description: Access rights must follow least privilege and be reviewed regularly.
logic: IF (access reviews not conducted within 6 months OR users have excessive privileges) THEN access_control_risk = 'high'

description: Incident response capabilities must be tested and updated based on lessons learned.
logic: IF (no incident response exercise in 12 months OR playbooks not updated after changes) THEN incident_readiness = 'uncertain' AND testing_gap = True

description: Supplier risk must be assessed before engagement and monitored throughout the relationship.
logic: IF (supplier without security assessment OR no security clauses in agreement) THEN supplier_risk = 'unmanaged' AND finding_severity = 'high'

description: Vulnerabilities must be remediated within defined SLAs based on severity.
logic: IF (critical_vulnerability_age > 30 days OR high_vulnerability_age > 90 days) THEN vulnerability_management_risk = 'high' AND remediation_gap = True

description: Business continuity plans must include information security requirements and be tested.
logic: IF (BCP does not address information security OR BCP not tested in 12 months) THEN continuity_readiness = 'insufficient'

description: Audit scope must cover all controls in the Statement of Applicability.
logic: IF (control in SoA not audited OR audit scope excludes significant sites/systems) THEN audit_coverage_gap = True AND finding_severity = 'medium'
